items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) will not practice Friday and is listed as doubtful vs Broncos. Sean McVay believes barring setback he could return next week vs Eagles.
items.why: Multiple DNPs, McVay: not making great progress earlier; now doubtful with next-week optimism.
items.implication: Sit Nacua Week 3; Adams primary beneficiary on targets/routes.
items.opportunity: Adams 42% target rate on 142 routes without Nacua historically; high snap/route share expected.

items.text: Jayden Daniels will not be placed on IR. Imaging and specialists make him week-to-week; out only this weekend vs Seahawks. Both team and player aiming return ASAP.
items.why: Elbow dislocation imaging positive enough to avoid IR; consensus week-to-week.
items.implication: Positive long-term; sit this week, monitor return timeline closely. Mariota or backup elevated short-term.
items.opportunity: Commanders pass catchers (McLaurin etc) face reduced QB quality this week.

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) status very much in doubt / not expected after multiple DNPs including Friday; Rapoport and beat reports indicate miss vs Colts likely second straight.
items.why: Grade 1 hamstring, no practice participation since initial injury; beat and Rapoport confirm bleak.
items.implication: Sit Collins; Schultz remains primary target hog.
items.opportunity: Schultz 28-30% target share sans Collins; elevated TE1 role, red-zone/third-down.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP multiple days, Rapoport notes does not bode well for Sunday participation in Brazil vs Cowboys; trending toward second straight miss.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated Week 1, no full practice; team cautious especially with travel/field concerns.
items.opportunity: Bateman solid WR2 volume; Andrews low-end TE2 opportunity share.

items.text: Packers first game without Jayden Reed: Christian Watson 45 routes, Matthew Golden 44 on 55 Love dropbacks. Watson & Golden combined 48% of Love targets so far.
items.why: Route distribution data post-Reed neck/back absence; high combined target share.
items.implication: Watson (and Golden) clear WR1/2 roles; start with confidence vs ATL.
items.opportunity: Nearly every-down routes; 48% target share duo; red-zone involvement for Watson.

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% route participation this season, six targets (8% share) through three games. Targets/route: 33% with London off, 17% with London on.
items.why: Low route % and target share data; dependent on London absence for efficiency.
items.implication: Fade/sit Pitts in typical lineups; London presence suppresses him heavily.
items.opportunity: Limited; only spikes if London out or heavy two-TE.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
items.why: Elite prop + worst rush defense matchup; volume expected in Brazil game.
items.implication: Strong RB1 start; smash spot for volume and TDs.
items.opportunity: High carry share vs soft run D; goal-line work.

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week without Nico Collins; IND allows 4th-most yards to TEs.
items.why: Proven target spike sans Collins + soft TE matchup.
items.opportunity: 28%+ targets, volume TE role vs weak coverage.

items.text: Loves Christian Watson vs ATL: WR8 utilization through two weeks, 38% red-zone target share. Since Week 11 last year WR9 in PPG (16.9).
items.why: Strong utilization + RZ share + recent PPG track record; Reed absence boosts further.
items.opportunity: High routes + RZ; aligns with Levitan route data.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Results in two missed games: 5-35-3 and 8-195-2. Massive opportunity boost.
items.why: Historical route/target data when Nacua off field; recent production spike.
items.implication: Adams must-start WR1 upside with Nacua doubtful/out.
items.opportunity: 42% target share on high route volume; red-zone/two-minute likely expanded.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization (86). PIT allows 5th-most rush yards to RBs.
items.why: Consistent high touches + target share + favorable rush matchup.
items.opportunity: 20+ touch floor, receiving work, soft run D.

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards. LV allows league-high 18.7 YPR to WRs.
items.why: Volume + aDOT + soft secondary allowing big plays.
items.opportunity: High target/air-yards share vs vulnerable pass D.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps, 5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs) and Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara).
items.why: Poor recent usage/role + tough matchups; no clear path to volume.
items.implication: Sit both; look elsewhere for RB depth.
items.opportunity: Low; committees and negative game scripts suppress.

items.text: Hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest FPs to WRs, 7.9 YPR allowed; WAS lowest implied total) and Rome Odunze vs PHI (12% targets, tough aDOT, Quinyon Mitchell, low team total).
items.why: Brutal matchups + low implied totals + usage concerns (esp Odunze target share; Daniels absence for McLaurin).
items.implication: Sit/flex down; avoid in DFS cash.
items.opportunity: Suppressed by defense and offense quality.
